title: Nothing you can see changed: towers can stand on rear wings
items: Nothing you can see changed yet. The kit the Prairie Avenue houses are built from can now stand a round or eight-sided tower on a rear wing's wall, rising past the wing's roof with its cone above it.
The wing's wall opens behind the tower, and the tower's back is closed where it rises over the wing.
It is the piece 1801 Prairie, the Kimball house, needs for the small turret on its east range.
